cases.situation: I already cancelled dinner with my friend Dani last month and now I have to cancel tomorrow's too because my son has a fever. I feel terrible.
cases.reply: Dani, I have to cancel tomorrow, Leo's got a fever and I can't leave him. I know that's twice now and I hate it, so this one's on me to fix: I've booked Saturday the 10th at 7 at Osteria Lupa, and I'll be there first. If that night's bad for you, pick one and I'll move it.
cases.note: Second cancel in a row means you do the rebooking, not them.

cases.situation: 明天下午两点约了客户陈总谈合同，结果老板临时让我去上海出差，得跟陈总改时间。微信说。
cases.reply: 陈总您好，明天下午两点的会面我需要改一下时间，公司临时安排我去上海出差，这么晚才通知您很抱歉。周四上午10点到12点，或者周五下午，我都可以，您看哪个方便？如果都不合适，您给我两个时间，我来配合。
cases.note: 对客户第一句就说改期，理由一句带过，然后直接给两个具体时间。

cases.situation: Committed to a camping trip with friends this weekend, cabin split is $80 each. I'm burnt out and want to drop out, don't want to reschedule. Group chat.
cases.reply: I've got to drop out of the Big Sur trip this weekend, sorry all. Nothing wrong, I'm just running on empty and need a quiet one. I'm still paying my $80 for the cabin, Venmo coming tonight. Have the best time and send me sunset photos.
cases.note: Covering your share is what makes a late drop-out land as honest rather than flaky.

cases.situation: I cancelled my sister's birthday lunch two hours before because of a work emergency. She replied 'fine, whatever'. I feel awful and want to fix it.
cases.reply: I get it, and I'm sorry. It was your birthday and I bailed on the day. I've booked Sunday at 12:30 at Lucia's, the place you loved in the spring, my treat. If Sunday doesn't work, tell me a day and I'll move it.
cases.note: Don't argue with 'fine'. Own it once, then do the rebooking yourself so the effort is visibly yours.
